note: 2026-11-23 0.135 G3 (PR #4375) members take their places when a group activity starts. A new revision of the Engine v2 entry eden:dance_together (content/kinds/together/dance_together.json); an entry's reference is the hash of its bytes, so the old revision keeps its bytes. It gains a ring of eight body slots 1 m round its middle (lead, d1 to d7), each with a stand point facing the middle, and each role lists its slots; both roles keep places in: here with within_mm 3000, so a dancer farther than 3 m from the middle is never walked to the ring. The world's pin of an activity kind (serve::activity_kinds) now hashes the stands its roles resolve to, as well as its roles, so six kinds whose entry bytes do not change get new pins: eden:handshake, eden:high_five, eden:hold_hands, eden:hug, eden:fist_bump and eden:harvest_together; eden:follow names no stands and keeps its pin. The client's pins (v2/client/src/together/together.mjs) are updated in the same change. A client still holding an old pin has its offers refused until it updates. No findings: no budgets, samples or gap checks were relaxed.
